motivation: external research found a documented daily-reversal edge in Indian equities (96-stock study, IC +0.020 large-cap / +0.025 midcap, +40% over 5.4y) and stated plainly that Indian large-caps are too efficient intraday for any intraday edge to survive

signal_measurement_no_strategy_no_parame.method: cross-sectional rank IC of prior N-day return vs forward M-day return across 66 NSE names, 2019-2026
signal_measurement_no_strategy_no_parame.verdict: reversal is real and stable only at lb=5/h=5, and its magnitude matches the published IC of 0.020 almost exactly

tradability.conclusion: the edge is statistically real but far too small to pay for Indian delivery costs. A 5-day signal on a 66-name universe implies several hundred times annual turnover, and a 0.23% round trip on that turnover costs far more than an IC of 0.02 can earn. Signal real, trade unprofitable.

overfitting_evidence: a 12-point parameter sweep on the full 2019-2026 period produced up to +13.68% CAGR, Sharpe 1.68, DD -12.95%, which looked like a gate pass
the same configuration returned +1.11% CAGR and Sharpe 0.154 on the untouched holdout
removing the momentum gate and extreme cutoff made results worse (-6.38% holdout), confirming those filters were merely masking a falling knife
no configuration of the 12-point sweep and no configuration of the 9-point pure-reversal grid passed the holdout gate
portable_lesson: measure the signal with an information coefficient before building a strategy around it. The IC test identified a real, stable, published-strength edge that every strategy-level test in this project had failed to distinguish from noise, and it also showed the edge is unmonetisable at Indian retail costs.
